rainy.notes: Wet pavement likely; waterproof outerwear and footwear recommended.

sunny.notes: Clear skies; breathable fabrics and sun protection recommended.

cold.notes: Near or below freezing; insulated layers recommended.

hot.notes: High heat; lightweight breathable clothing recommended.

snowy.notes: Snow accumulation likely; waterproof insulated boots and layers recommended.

windy.notes: Strong gusts likely; a windproof outer layer is recommended.

mild.notes: Comfortable temperatures; light layering works well.
